Author: Asteria Nocturna
Name: Divination.AetheryteLinkInChat
Punchline: Quick teleport for mob hunts and treasure hunts!
Description: Display a teleport link to the nearest aetherite for the map link from the in-game chat. Type /alic to configure the plugin.
Changelog:
6f7ea10: Merge pull request #810 from SlashNephy/feat/alic-print-conditions

feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add options to skip own messages and local Lifestream links
5b47730: feat(AetheryteLinkInChat): add options to skip own messages and local Lifestream links

- "Hide the Lifestream link for messages about the current world":
  skip the Lifestream link when the world detected from the message is
  the current world
- "Do not add teleport links to your own messages": skip messages sent
  by the local player

Both are disabled by default, so the current behaviour is unchanged.

Close #677

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
05acc63: Merge pull request #809 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-reconnect

fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection
47500d7: fix(FaloopIntegration): log the whole spawn_location payload

Passing the nullable ZonePoiId alone as the params argument of the log
call made it a null array when the value was null (CS8604). Log the
whole payload instead, as the spawn case does.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
3cf9a9e: fix(FaloopIntegration): reconnect with a new client after disconnection

After "transport close", SocketIOClient's own reconnection kept the
engine.io session alive (pings continued) but the plugin never received
mob reports again until it was disabled and enabled.

Handle reconnection in the plugin instead, mirroring what re-enabling
the plugin does:

- Disable SocketIOClient's reconnection
- Run a connection loop that logs in again and connects with a new
  Socket.IO client on every disconnection, with exponential backoff
  from 5 seconds up to 5 minutes
- Time out a connection attempt that the server never accepts, since
  ConnectAsync only times out at the transport level
- Stop retrying when the credentials are rejected
- Ignore events from clients that have already been replaced

Refs #687

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
3e3cbf9: Merge pull request #808 from SlashNephy/docs/api13-repository

docs: describe the Dalamud API 13 repository
d2aee34: docs: describe the Dalamud API 13 repository

Point clients that are still on Dalamud API 13, such as the Traditional
Chinese client, to plugins/api13.json, which serves the frozen
AetheryteLinkInChat 7.3.1.14 build.

Refs #727

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
0f2ec49: Merge pull request #807 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-pending-spawn-location

fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later
6daa4d0: fix(FaloopIntegration): announce spawns whose location is reported later

When "Ignore Pending Report" is enabled, a spawn reported without
coordinates was dropped before being stored, so the following
spawn_location could not find it and was ignored as well.

- Hold location-less spawns as pending and announce them once
  spawn_location arrives
- Accept a null zonePoiId in spawn_location and a singular zonePoiId in spawn
- Replace the stored report on location change instead of appending

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
8b422a6: Merge pull request #805 from SlashNephy/fix/faloop-messaging-socket

fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint
01daabc: fix(FaloopIntegration): connect to Faloop's new Socket.IO endpoint

Faloop's frontend update (2026-10-30) moved the Socket.IO endpoint from
/comms/socket.io to the /legacy namespace on /messaging/socket.io/.
The old endpoint still accepts connections but no longer delivers mob
reports, so follow the new endpoint.

Close #804

Co-Authored-By: Claude Mythos 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
d2ea413: feat: use a divination-deploy App token instead of DEPLOY_GITHUB_TOKEN (#799)

reusable-deploy-plugin.yml checks out the distribution repository, opens
a pull request there and merges it. Mint a GitHub App installation token
scoped to that repository instead of using a bot PAT.

Drop the Authorization header when fetching commits.json. This
repository is public so the request needs no authentication, and
expanding a token on the command line exposes it through the process
list.

Reference the reusable workflow by local path. Pinning it by SHA means a
change here does not take effect until every caller is updated, which
would leave a broken intermediate state whenever a secret is renamed.

Drop the explicit create-pull-request author: it defaults to
github.actor, which attributes the deployment to whoever triggered it.

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
